full_judgment:
Mustafa Kamal, J.: In Money Suit No. 186 of 1978 of the 3rd . Court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka, the plaintiff Gazi Abdur Rashid claimed Tk. 35,31,911'00 with interest from 1.10.77 @ 15% against the defendants, but the trial Court, by judgment and decree dated 19.9.84, partially decreed the suit for Tk. 15,39,300'00 against defendant Nos. 1-3, the present appellants in CA No. 61 of 1990, and for Tk. 1,58,210'00 against defendant No.4, No interest was given. Defendant Nos. 1-3 and 4 preferred two separate first appeals, FA Nos. 17 and 19 of 1985 and the plaintiff also filed Cross- objection No. 18 of 1985 against the trial Court's judgment and decree. Hearing and disposing them of together, by the impugned judgment and decree dated 25.3.90 a Division Bench of the High Court Division, Dhaka dismissed both the first appeals and partly allowed the cross-objection of the plaintiff, further decreeing the suit for Tk. 6,82,100.00 against defendant No.4 and for Tk. 23,438'00 against defendant No.5. 

 2. Defendant Nos. 1-3 have preferred Civil Appeal No. 61 of 1990 and the plaintiff has preferred Civil Appeal No. 68 of 1990 against the impugned judgment and decree of the High Court Division. Both the appeals have been heard together and will be disposed of by this common judgment. 

 24. We hold, therefore, that the High Court Division correctly affirmed the trial Court's decree for Tk. 12,24,800'00. 

 28. The High Court Division therefore in our view have correctly affirmed the trial Court's decree in respect of Tk. 3,14,500'00. 

 31. In the plaint the plaintiff did not ask for Tk. 7,00,000.00 under any separate head. In the detailed statement of claim, the amount of Tk. 7,00,000'00 is concealed in his claim for Tk. 5.52,078'00 being the balance of C/D account. The plaintiff has explained this claimed amount of Tk, 5,52.078'00 in paragraph 21 of the plaint. There he has claimed various other amounts in respect of various other heads, claim for Tk, 7,00,000.00 being one of those, and after adjustment of the same he has finally claimed Tk, 5,52,078.00. In this suit, therefore, there cannot be a further decree Crore Tk. 7,00,000'00. This suit can only be further decreed for Tk. 5,52,078'00 after giving a decision on the other heads of claims and adjustments contained in paragraph 21 of the plaint. Mr. Asrarul Hossain rightly submits that the plaintiff cannot obtain this relief in this money suit without suing for accounts. 

 35. We do not propose to award any interest to the plaintiff on the decretal sum from the date of the decree upto realisation, because by not granting the same the trial Court shall be deemed to have refused it. 

 36. We, however, hold that the plaintiff-appellant ought to be awarded a reasonable interest from the date of the institution of the suit upto the date of the decree of this Court. 

 In the result Civil Appeal No. 61 of 1990 is dismissed with costs and Civil Appeal No. 68 of 1990 is allowed in part without costs. The plaintiff- appellant's claim of Tk. 7,00,000.00 in CA No. 68 of 1990 is not allowed but we allow interest on the decretal sum of Tk. 15,39,300.00 @ 7 and a half per annum from the date of the institution of the suit upto the date of decree of this Court.
